description: What must never appear on the control channel. fake_secrets are the stand-ins the helper's tests sign in and join with (the values voice/conch-voice/src/lib.rs's tests use): none may appear in any line either side writes, nor in any fixture here except the one conformance case that shows an unknown field named token being ignored. forbidden_field_fragments may not occur in the name of any field of any message of the protocol.
